title: karpenter chart values (partial schema)
description: Validates the settings.flavors overrides and the boolean toggles at helm install/upgrade time, before a typo reaches the controller. The booleans need typing because the templates gate on Go-template truthiness, where any non-empty string is true: a quoted "false" (--set-string, or a quoted values file) would render the exact opposite of its intent. Everything else is intentionally unconstrained.

enabled.description: Expose the metrics endpoint through a ClusterIP service.

disableLeaderElection.description: Disable leader election. The string "false" would still disable it — two active controllers with replicas>1.

enabled.description: Enable the dynamic price/flavor refresher. The string "false" would render PRICING_REFRESH_ENABLED="true".

name.description: Flavor name (e.g. 2XS..XL). A name outside the built-in catalogue introduces a new flavor and must also set cpu, memoryKi and priceHourly.
